decisions.selection: Deep undo and redo through all retained promoted history entries, with no arbitrary one-level/64-entry durable depth cap.
contract: One per-file global promoted-history order is the default, preserving HIS002 most-recent entry semantics. History-query includes actor attribution; explicit target-entry revert is a separate typed operation, not a silently changed default actor filter.

Undo/redo are new receipted promoted operations referencing the original entry and inverse lineage. New accepted edit after undo starts a new active history branch; previously undone branch remains queryable/auditable and may be explicitly replayed as a new proposal.

Inverse commands and snapshot-backed patches validate current object/property read/write preconditions. Never replace the whole document to erase intervening unrelated work. Stale/overlapping inverse yields conflict and an inspectable proposal, not successful undo or silently skipped entry.

Redo depth is limited only by retained reachable history and artifact availability under host retention policy. Cache budgets bound resident entries and load older entries on demand; eviction does not delete durable history or reachable snapshots. Missing artifact yields actionable unavailable outcome, never approximate reconstruction.

Draft-local Yjs undo is separately scoped by transaction origin and explicit gesture boundary. It never claims to undo promoted authority. Retain existing Yjs-compatible update-log selection and pre-promotion boundary; no new Loro/Automerge engine.

Every promoted batch remains auditable, including history-control commands. Undo/redo navigation uses explicit semantic-entry lineage/cursor; repeated undo selects the preceding still-applied semantic edit, not the just-recorded undo control receipt. Reverting a history-control operation is explicit redo, preventing an undo/redo loop.
decisions.basis: HIS001-004 require unified ledger-backed history. PhotoCraft ops stores max64 COW snapshot states and clears redo; useful memory-budget example, unsuitable durable authority. Yjs documents origin-scoped selective undo and stopCapturing; use only draft mechanics.
rejected: One-level durable redo cap discards useful retained capability
Copy PhotoCraft in-memory pop as authority
Whole-document snapshot restore overwrites concurrent work
proof: Promote3 domains, undo3, redo3, restart and independently reread canonical heads/events/artifacts
New edit after undo: branch preserved but active redo unavailable

Default global Undo selects most-recent applied semantic entry across actors. Separately, explicit older target-entry revert preserves foreign disjoint edit and conflicts on overlapping edit, with exact entry/property evidence; do not use this latter proof to imply default actor-local Undo.
Cold cache still replays retained history; missing snapshot never reports success

decisions.selection: Explicit semantic command-batch/gesture boundaries; accepted event stream is lossless. Coalesce only replaceable uncommitted previews.
contract: A gesture binds actor/session/document, command ID, gesture ID, base target revisions and descriptor/profile version at begin; bounded delta chunks feed a private draft; end submits one proposal batch and one unified history entry.

Record every ordered nonreplaceable input necessary for replay, or its immutable typed artifact reference and digest, plus deterministic seeds/provider/version. Pointer pressure/time samples required by brush semantics remain ordered; never drop them merely to retain final cursor position.

The22 canonical semantic event types retain their identities. A transaction may emit multiple typed semantic events in one batch with deterministic order/sequence, correlation, causation, actor, payload hashes and one promotion receipt. Do not force mixed-domain batches into a generic mutation event.

Only an uncommitted preview with same actor/document/gesture/output slot may supersede another preview. Surface typed superseded/stale revision. Never merge across actors, files, distinct commands or accepted batches.

Exact shared SHL194 exit map: release, focus loss, modal opening and400ms after last wheel notch finalize the valid gesture once through actor-specific host promotion/approval. Escape restores the pre-press private draft value and closes exactly one receipted aborted history-scope entry with no document-content mutation; this entry is distinguishable from promoted semantic edits and excluded from undo/redo cursor. Explicit cancellation similarly closes aborted scope. No exit bypasses proposal approval. After acceptance cancellation requires Chronicle undo. Finalize rechecks foreign-write footprints/grants; stale conflict closes failed scope without content mutation. Lease/stop epoch changes reject stale chunks. Bounded compute chunks retain one semantic gesture and ordered replay artifact under ARC admission.
Recovery rediscoveries resolve the same promotion idempotency key; no per-frame automatic promotion or time-window heuristic creates multiple unintended history entries.
decisions.basis: ARC011/013 already separate serialized promotion from replaceable preview; Yjs500ms capture default is not a reliable semantic authority boundary.
rejected: One authority event per mouse move
Drop oldest accepted edit on overloaded queue
proof: Pressure-sensitive long stroke replays exact output digest after restart

decisions.selection: Default auto-accept OFF. Support bounded operator-preauthorized policy evaluated by the host, never by the authoring model.
contract: Host policy identifies operator grant/receipt, immutable policy version, explicit command allowlist, document/object scope, resource and diff limits, validator catalog/version, expiry/revocation, author separation and required audit fields. A proposal cannot set or relax these fields.

Initial eligible class is deterministic reversible in-document parameter/style edits to existing explicitly granted objects, with no unresolved/blocking validation, no schema loss and an available validated inverse. Eligibility alone is not approval: matching unrevoked operator policy is required.

Delete/destructive flatten, external filesystem overwrite/export, import replacement, plugin install/code/expression activation, network/process/credential actions, asset retirement and governance decisions stay outside this class. They retain their existing host approval boundary.

Preview/actor-local view state requires no authority promotion; do not call it auto-accept. Recheck current grants/footprints and policy at promotion transaction, record the genuine host policy decision and validation run, preserve rejection evidence.

WP012 PromotionGate::decide currently insists on approval_source=operator_review_receipt. Add a typed host policy approval variant through the existing owner before enabling auto-accept; never counterfeit that operator source or fabricate a review receipt. Spec evaluate/implementation decide naming needs adapter reconciliation, not a parallel gate.

Policy revocation prevents subsequent promotions; it does not silently erase earlier accepted work. Operator controls enrollment and limits; safe OFF default permits implementation preparation without asking operator to choose a technical default.

Allowlist is semantic and versioned, not a label based on a scalar payload. Parameter/style operations that retire content, hide/remove objects, change external references, activate code or produce irreversible effects remain excluded even if encoded as one property. Unknown operation risk is ineligible.
decisions.basis: PW003 explicitly blocks self-approval; direct promotion.rs225-273 validates genuine operator source and passed artifact-bound validation.
proof: Forged source/author-granted policy denied
Expired/revoked/out-of-scope policy denied without authority rows

decisions.selection: Typed tile/object metadata and content-addressed artifact references in Folio/SurrealDB; bulk raster bytes in the existing artifact tier. Draft CRDT carries typed references/operations, never pixel blobs or a second authoritative tile database.
contract: Tile identity includes canonical object/layer/grid coordinate, format/color/schema, dimensions and content hash. Avoid pointer-address COW identities from PhotoCraft; content identity must survive processes/restart.

Persist validated immutable artifact bytes before accepting their reference. Serialized SurrealDB transaction checks grants, target versions and complete read/write footprints then writes references, accepted head, events and idempotency outcome atomically.

Disjoint tile writes may both promote only if their declared reads remain valid. Same-tile or dependent backdrop/effect reads conflict unless a deterministic semantic rebase is validated against current state. Pixel-region disjointness alone does not prove filters/brushes independent.

Yjs-compatible draft stores addressable operation/proposal IDs and typed refs; draft convergence never approves last-writer-wins tile authority. Unsupported/lossy schema mapping blocks promotion with preserved evidence.

Snapshots/history reuse artifact references. Uncommitted/orphan blobs are reclaimable only through existing host lifecycle after reachable accepted/history/draft/proposal/export references are accounted for. No cleanup performed by Studio leaf code.

ResourceBroker reserves decoded and retained bytes before decode/cache/fanout; canceled or superseded outputs release owned leases, never foreign graph resources. Missing/hash-mismatched artifact is a typed integrity failure.
decisions.basis: RAS116 already resolves bulk-byte exclusion. ARC011 rules out blanket CAS; kernel crdt_adr72-77 selects Surreal update-log/Yjs-compatible draft boundary.

decisions.selection: Register all22 STUDIO wire variants and an explicit corresponding FR-EVT-STUDIO family through existing host catalogs and durable mirror lifecycle.
contract: Generate the mapping from the existing canonical event catalog, preserving wire and family IDs; every variant enters required_first_slice_events and strict payload/schema/version validation. No duplicate Studio recorder/catalog or generic System-only substitute for business registration.

Envelope binds document/workspace, canonical actor/session, batch/promotion/event IDs, sequence/correlation/causation, exact revision, payload hash and typed artifact refs. Denials/proposals/previews are distinguishable from accepted authority events.

Durable authority receipt precedes mirror attempt. Reuse inspected native-editor pending/completion reconciliation pattern, not its editor-specific schema. FR uses deterministic workspace-partitioned ID, verifies immutable matching envelope on retry, and claims mirrored only after exact FR row exists.

Mirror failure does not undo an accepted authority mutation or claim FR completion. Pending state remains observable/recoverable; restart reconciles without duplicate rows and rejects same-ID/different-payload collision.

Audio callbacks use preallocated bounded POD handoff to off-thread aggregation; never call locking general recorder. Overrun records discontinuity/loss with bounded safe output, not silent successful recording. Workspace read/grant filtering remains host-owned.
